newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM International sees Q4 exceeding Q3.
newsitem.headline: ASM International sees Q4 exceeding Q3.

text.p: Advanced Semiconductors Materials International NV said on Wednesday it expected 1996 fourth quarter profits to be higher than in the third quarter of this year.
"Fourth quarter results are expected to exceed those of the third quarter," the company said in a statement.

In the third quarter of this year ASM International's net profit fell to 6.8 million guilders from 23.3 million in the year-ago period. Third quarter net per share fell to 0.20 guilders from 0.69. The company said the profit fall reflected a large order cancellation which had already been predicted.
Net profits for the first nine months of 1996 rose to 61.2 million guilders from 45.6 million.
ASM International, which makes equipment to manufacture semiconductors, is NASDAQ-listed but said in October it had applied for a listing on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.
Detailed information on the Amsterdam flotation will be published in December, the company said on Wednesday.
